summary: Mobile (390x844) + Desktop (1280x800) re-audit after iteration_81. Found and FIXED one CRITICAL runtime crash in PopularProducts.js (uppercase reference `VISIBLE` instead of `visible` at line 203 — broke entire popular-products component with 'VISIBLE is not defined' ReferenceError). After fix, all mobile criteria pass: no horizontal page scroll anywhere, 2 cards visible on mobile (prices intact), add-popular buttons visible/tappable, promo banner constrained, mobile menu logged-out shows correct items, tap targets meet minimums. Desktop layout regression-checked and intact.

ui_bugs.issue: Line 203 referenced undefined uppercase constant `VISIBLE` in fallback `width: cardPx ? ${cardPx}px : ${100 / VISIBLE}%`. Triggered 'ReferenceError: VISIBLE is not defined' on every page that renders PopularProducts (home, catalog). React error overlay (Uncaught runtime errors) showed and the popular-products section crashed. Testing agent replaced VISIBLE with the existing state variable `visible`. Verified post-fix: 2 cards now render on mobile with prices '1 600 ₽' and '700 ₽' not truncated, green circular add-to-cart buttons visible at bottom-right of each card.

action_items: (Already fixed by testing agent) VISIBLE→visible typo in PopularProducts.js:203. Main agent should keep the fix and add an ESLint rule or jsx lint pre-commit to catch unresolved identifiers.
Consider adding a unit/smoke test that mounts <PopularProducts /> with a minimal product list to prevent regressions like the VISIBLE typo from shipping.
critical_code_review_comments: PopularProducts.js had no test coverage and used a manually-spelled identifier in a JSX style string — exactly the kind of silent runtime bug a JSX/JS lint setup with `no-undef` would catch. Recommend enforcing eslint:recommended.

Admin tab affordance code (sm:hidden chevron + gradient) should expose a data-testid (e.g., admin-tabs-fade, admin-tabs-chevron) so testers can deterministically assert its presence without DOM heuristics.

If the main agent overwrites/restructures PopularProducts.js, re-verify there are no undefined identifiers and that the component renders without throwing. All other mobile mobile-only fixes from this iteration are visually + measurement-confirmed working (no horizontal scroll on any page at 390px, desktop intact at 1280px).
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: developer renamed the fixed constant VISIBLE to a stateful `visible` value (responsive 2/3/6) but missed one usage inside a JSX inline style fallback expression. JavaScript does not throw at parse time for undefined identifiers; it only fails at runtime when that line executes during render, causing a fatal React render error that wiped the popular-products UI. Reproduction: load any page rendering <PopularProducts /> at any viewport. Mitigation applied: replace `VISIBLE` with `visible`. Long-term: enable `no-undef` ESLint rule and a smoke render test.
